title: A Cold Day for Tom
text:
Today is cold and rainy. Tom wears a red coat, a hat and warm boots. His sister wears a blue dress and a sweater. They walk to school together.

At school, Tom takes off his coat because the room is warm. His sister does not need her sweater now. Later, the sun comes out and the day becomes warm. They are happy.

questions.text: What is the weather like today?
What does Tom take off at school?
Why does Tom's sister not need her sweater later?
What kind of day is it at the end of the story?

vocabulary.definition: a warm piece of clothing you wear over other clothes
a warm piece of clothing for the upper body, usually made of wool
having a comfortable, fairly high temperature
shoes that cover the foot and the lower part of the leg

paragraph_translations: Hoje está frio e chovendo. Tom usa um casaco vermelho, um chapéu e botas quentes. A irmã dele usa um vestido azul e um suéter. Eles caminham juntos para a escola.
Na escola, Tom tira o casaco porque a sala está quente. A irmã dele não precisa mais do suéter. Depois, o sol aparece e o dia fica quente. Eles estão felizes.
